referent_preflight.principle: Resolve implicit pronouns and witness verbs to an exact event and the current conversation topic; actor's participation in a different event at the same location never supplies eyewitness authority. Even quotes absent from protected keyword triggers need semantic audit.
mandatory_for: Ambiguous 'в лесу','там','он','что произошло','это' after named person
Hidden plans, medical observations and previously unseen actions
referent_preflight.fail_closed: No source -> no unqualified witnessed claim; no referent -> specify referent or decline factual assertion; do not fabricate reports
referent_preflight.contract: Each signed NPC dialogue sentence with positive 'видел/видели/наблюдал/слышал' must have a same-position referent_audit row whose quote equals the entire sentence. Global knowledge_review.scene_focus_entity is required for ambiguous deictic references. Episode scope must match conversation focus unless the sentence explicitly names a different event subject. The actor must be listed as an eyewitness of the event and must not occur in known_non_witnesses.
referent_preflight.sentence_scope: Split on sentence-final punctuation; one row per witness clause, not one per dialogue line. Explicit switch of entity only accepted when named in the same clause.
